summary: Both blocking findings are valid compatibility gaps and should be repaired in spec.json. Non-blocking improvements are advisory only.

items.title: Workflow flowIntegration behavior can be removed without a replacement
items.rationale: The spec removes workflow-specific skill text but does not define the observable replacement for existing workflow.flowIntegration issue-start behavior.
items.evidence: spec.json requirements[R9] and task T-9 mention moving behavior to hooks but do not state whether issue-start is preserved by an official workflow plugin hook or temporary core behavior.

items.title: Top-level workflow config migration path is missing
items.rationale: The config namespace requirement covers plugin.config.<pluginId> but does not specify handling for existing top-level workflow.flowIntegration.
items.evidence: spec.json constraints mention plugin.repos/packages[].repo migration only; R8 names plugin.config.<pluginId> defaults but not top-level workflow config migration or preservation.
